optional_features.compact_fallback_reason: lookup supplied proposals; draft head skipped

selection.promotion_rule: observed sweep differences are candidates; require paired verification before changing any baseline parameter; Q4H remains fixed by user preference

metric_definition.median: median of all three native batches; no slow sample removed
metric_definition.relative_median: median of each round ratio against same-round baseline; these are not adjacent paired samples
metric_definition.request_decode_tok_s: 16384 / per-request decode wall time including interleaving
metric_definition.batch_decode_tok_s: C * 16384 / sum of Engine decode cycle wall seconds
